headline: Toyota September Global Sales and Production Fall for Third Consecutive Month
summary: Toyota Motor saw both worldwide vehicle sales and factory production slide in September, representing the automaker's third consecutive monthly decline.
why: Toyota is the world's top-selling automaker; persistent slowdowns in its production highlight ongoing supply hurdles and changing vehicle demand across key global markets.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor
impacts.why: A third consecutive monthly decline in output and sales weighs on revenue expectations.

why_moved: Toyota shares faced downward pressure after data revealed a third consecutive monthly contraction in worldwide sales and factory output.
